clips.send: A parent sends it to whoever still has baby powder in the house - the fear of what else is sitting in the bathroom cabinet.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's Kevin-Was-Right file: remember Johnson's Baby Powder? It's already off the market.

His point: it hasn't been formally banned by the FDA - it was pulled before that had to happen, after decades of talc lawsuits.

His view on the agencies that oversee products like this: plenty of people there are doing the job right, and some aren't - which is exactly why he says check the label yourself before you trust it.

Do you know what's actually in the powder or lotion in your own bathroom cabinet?
